atoms.text: Adverbien, die zwei oder mehr Silben haben und auf -ly enden, werden mit more und the most gesteigert.
atoms.sound: Adverbien, die zwei oder mehr Silben haben und auf - l y enden werden mit <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>more</voice> und <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>the most</voice> gesteigert.

example.a:
The mole moves slowly.
The turtle moves more slowly.
The slug moves the most slowly.
example.sound: ssml: The mole moves slowly. The turtle moves more slowly. The slug moves the most slowly.

atoms.a: Skye asks his English teacher politely for help.
They breathe more deeply during their yoga class.
We have to watch our dog more carefully in the future.
He is the one in the band who can play the cello the most skilfully.
She studies the most quietly when she is in the library.
